content.text: {"name":"V05_yoy_persist6_highT","hypothesis":"Groups with a higher share of positive monthly changes in V05 over the window, applied only in high-T regimes, have higher next-month returns than groups with a lower share, so the cross-sectional rank correlation is positive.","falsified_if":"Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or negative, or the HAC t-statistic is below 1.5 in development statistics.","expression":"regime(persist(V05,6),\"high\")"}
